verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SigNoz ingesting data from standard OpenTelemetry SDKs, which are third-party, vendor-neutral libraries rather than SigNoz's own official SDKs. The pack also documents an MCP server, Agent Skills and service-account API access, but those are separate capabilities and earn no credit for this story. No first-party SigNoz SDK, client library or OpenAPI spec is evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
